## v0.20.0 cut: UI test failures (open point 1)

Sources: the local gate logs in `gate-logs/` (`release-2026111x-*`, `batch-2026111x-*`), release PR #1694, the post-merge runs of 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-14. PR #1694 did not use `cut.yml` (#1690), so no `cut.yml` run exists for v0.20.0.

**Finding: no UI test failed in the v0.20.0 release gate.**
- The release gate ran local, `--no-snapshots`, on `182b7018a`, in 86.6 min. The `camcraft-ui` lib had 774 passed, 5 ignored. All 16 UI test binaries passed.
- The red steps of the cut were not UI: `step_agreement` (#1697, PR #1698), `shared_face_bodies` (#1706, PR #1712), app `stock_source_*` (#1691, PR #1692).
- The release branch has no UI fix and no PNG regeneration. The snapshot lanes were skipped.

**The UI time came from two other places:**

| Test | When | Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `egui_app::tests::setup_mount_pages::each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount` | main, 2026-11-14 10:49Z-15:31Z, before the v0.20.0 cut | post refused, 18 warnings | real behaviour: PR #1622 put Face under the stock-source keep law; the test fixture faced through the block. The fixture was wrong. | `f0fdd977c`, PR #1660 (#1657) |
| `egui_app::tests::egui_shell_snapshot` | v0.19.0 cut, 2026-11-13 | about 27,000 pixels differ | look: pixel golden out of date | `0b176414c` (goldens regenerated) |
| `egui_app::tests::egui_shell_snapshot_light` | v0.19.0 cut | about 26,600 pixels differ | look | `0b176414c` |
| `egui_app::tests::tool_editor_snapshot` | v0.19.0 cut | about 113,500 pixels differ | look | `0b176414c` |

The three snapshot failures stopped two release gates of v0.19.0 in sequence. Each rerun of the release gate took about 50 min. They passed only after the regeneration commit.

**Count:** 3 look failures (pixels), 1 real behaviour failure, 0 UI flakes. #605 (a parallel race in `shell_structure_*`) is a known flake, but it did not occur in these windows.

**Limits of this reading:**
- No record of six hours of UI retests is in the PR, the issues or the gate logs. Reruns by hand or in chat sessions leave no log. The "6 hours" is probably the v0.19.0 snapshot reruns plus the `setup_mount_pages` red window on the v0.20.0 day.
- The post-merge logs give step summaries only. The name of the failed test in run 43587095462 is taken from the #1657 timeline.

**Item 6, wall times of the UI suites:**

| Lane | Wall time |
|---|---|
| post-merge batch, Linux, step `ui suites (cwd crates/ui)` | 61-78 s (one run 157 s) |
| local batch, Windows | 93-147 s (one run 233 s) |
| local release gate | v0.20.0: 129 s; v0.19.0: 62-99 s |
| `cut.yml` release, Linux (v0.21.0) | 52-67 s |
| ui snapshot lane (debug, `--ignored`) | about 5 s; GPU render snapshot lane about 2 s |

The UI suites are not slow. The cost of a UI failure at a cut is the full release gate rerun (50-90 min), not the UI suite.

**What the refit can do without the pixel snapshots (open point 2):** each look assertion that a PR must keep is in a structural test of the default suite. The snapshot lanes then only show the new look one time at the cut, and a human accepts the new PNGs. The refit gets no gate failures from the PNGs, because the cut regenerates them in one commit (root `AGENTS.md`, "Pixel snapshots are release-lane").

## Item 1: inventory of the UI tests that a refit can break

Reading of `origin/main` at `cda3d5896`. Kind: **B** = asserts behaviour (AccessKit labels, roles, enabled state, commands, document state). **L** = asserts layout (positions, sizes, colours, pixels). **B+L** = both.

**Counts**

| Place | Files | `#[test]` | ignored | B / L / B+L files |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crates/ui/tests/` | 15 | 127 | 1 | 11 / 2 / 2 |
| `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` | 1 | 86 | 3 (the 3 pixel snapshots) | B+L |
| `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/*.rs` | 70 | 280 | 1 | 55 / 3 / 12 |
| other `cfg(test)` in `crates/ui/src` | 108 | 458 | 2 | 36 drive a `Harness` |

**Pixel lanes:** `egui_shell_snapshot`, `egui_shell_snapshot_light`, `tool_editor_snapshot` (`tests.rs`), and `docs_images_snapshot_match_the_rendered_steps` (`tests/gpu_render.rs`). `review_1710_evidence` is a manual evidence capture (ignored).

**Files of the integration suites that a new look can break:**
- `tests/theme_files.rs` (B+L): pins the literal tokens of the built-in themes (for example DARK accent `0x356DA8`). A new built-in theme breaks it by design.
- `tests/boundary_picks.rs` (B+L): mark colours by palette role. A restyle that keeps the roles holds.
- `tests/gpu_render.rs`, `tests/trace_composite.rs` (L): viewport GPU pixels. Only a viewport colour change breaks them.

**L and B+L files in `src/egui_app/tests/`:** `structural`, `fixture_rows`, `review_1710_evidence` (L); `tests.rs`, `fixtures_page`, `gcode_viewer`, `layout`, `machine_page`, `plane_face_pick`, `setup_settings_page`, `stock_size`, `theme_door`, `tool_icon_wiring`, `tool_list_page` (B+L). In other `src` files: `wcs_page_tests` (L), `viewport_ground_tests`, `colorvision_tests`, `gcode_highlight` (palette literals), `viewport_bar`, `viewport_layout`, `law_tests` (Hud geometry).

### Behaviour tests that also pin the look (input to item 2)

**Group A: hard-coded screen points.** These assume where a pane is.
- `tests.rs` `click_outside_the_viewport_is_not_a_pick`: clicks `pos2(4.0, 4.0)`.
- `tests.rs` `origin_page_shows_the_anchor_grid…` and `one_wcs.rs` `the_wcs_page_shows_the_work_offset_dropdown…`: wheel at `pos2(1100.0, 500.0)`.
- `layout.rs` `the_viewport_row_is_inert_and_the_door_dismisses_outside`: clicks `pos2(640.0, 712.0)`.
- `model_incomplete.rs` `incomplete_model_page_and_import_status…`: finds the status by `rect().min.y > 600.0`.
- `structural.rs` `shell_structure_dark` / `_light`: the status line and Debug info at `y > 600.0`.
- `geo_row_hover.rs`, `edge_click_modifiers.rs`: park the pointer at `pos2(1.0, 1.0)`.

**Group B: browser rows by arithmetic.** `BROWSER_TREE_TOP = 150.0`, `BROWSER_EYE_X = 220.0`, `row * row_height`. Used in `tests.rs` (`stock_eye_hides…`, `dragging_an_operation_row_reorders…`, `operations_heading_menu_pastes…`, `operation_type_menu_requires_confirmation`, `operation_menu_suppresses_and_sets…`) and `program_entry.rs`. The browser rows are painted. They have no AccessKit node, so a label query cannot find them yet.

**Group C: ribbon cells by plan geometry.** About 35 tests click `cell.rect.center()` from `mill_plan_at(1280.0)` / `view_rows_of` / `recent_drop::rows_of` / `theme_drop::rows_of`. They hold while the ribbon is the full-width strip at the top. Files: `tests.rs` (13 tests), `first_setup`, `layout` (4), `recent_door` (7), `theme_door` (2), `setup_picks_disarm` (2), `machines_pane` / `machines_edit` (through `open_machines`). The ribbon cells are painted, so they also have no AccessKit node.

**Group D: sizes and colours inside behaviour tests.** `fixtures_page.rs` (equal button width), `gcode_viewer.rs` (window size, highlight fill colour, row height), `plane_face_pick.rs` (pick ink colour, radius, stroke width), `tool_icon_wiring.rs` (icon inside the row), `tests.rs` `every_registry_kind_gets_its_tab_bar` (filters nodes by `left() >= "Operation: ".left()`).

**Group E: derived from the live layout.** The viewport picks use `project_uv` and `state.viewport_rect`; the cube tests use `viewcube::Hud`. These follow a moved pane. They break only if the viewport or the cube changes.

**Pages and dialogs** (the list for item 3): the property pages of `UiTarget` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`): Stock, WCS, Model, Tool library, Tool, Operation, Setups, and the setup pages Settings, Machine, Post, Fixtures, Tools. The windows: tool editor, G-code viewer, machine editor, Post refused, Debug info. The modals: fixture library, unsaved prompt. The shell: ribbon, browser, viewport, properties, status strip.

The PR for this issue takes Group A and the shell skeleton. Groups B and C need AccessKit nodes for painted rows and cells first; I file them as follow-up issues.
